title.en: Continuous Diffusion Language Models for Dummies - Part 1
title.zh: 连续扩散语言模型入门：概念与常见误区 - Part 1

summary.en: A beginner’s guide to continuous diffusion language models: continuous generative states, denoising, parallel token updates, and the dependencies that make tokens work together.
summary.zh: 从连续生成状态与去噪过程出发，理解连续扩散语言模型的定义、架构选择、并行生成与 token 之间的依赖关系，澄清常见概念误区。

cover.alt: Continuous token states are refined together, from noise to language.
